journey.name: Lernweg · Campus
journey.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a real background illustration for ClassJourney, a teaching display for Swiss vocational teenagers, wide landscape 16:9. This is the actual app background, NOT a UI mockup.
Art direction: premium contemporary editorial illustration with confident clean sculptural paper-cut shapes and a little tasteful 2.5D depth. Fresh, optimistic, punchy, visually distinctive, professional enough for an educational product, appealing to 16–20 year olds. Rich teal, cobalt, warm apricot, lilac and cream with a few sunny-yellow accents. Use a controlled palette of four main colors per scene, excellent harmonious color blocks and precise shape design, bright clean light. NO washed-out beige filter, hospital brochure photography, watercolor haze, generic corporate stock art or childish mascots. Avoid neon, rainbow clutter, stickers everywhere, faces or confetti.
Composition: a designed topical learning world whose objects sit mainly along the LOWER THIRD and OUTER EDGES. Keep the CENTRAL 55% and upper half spacious, smooth and mostly warm light cream so the app's text, clock and moving white cards remain readable. Strong colorful interesting forms at the edges, generous visual breathing room. A graceful narrow path or ribbon connects the outer scene elements as a journey motif, not a clinical procedure. No text, numerals, labels, branding, signs, app controls, cards, clocks, frames or watermark. NO mountains or generic landscapes unless explicitly called for. Theme: a lively modern Swiss learning campus. A curved cobalt walkway along the lower area linking a terracotta-red-orange stair and turquoise geometric school-building forms on the far left to an abstract apricot arch and a few sculptural plants at the far right. Low clean pavilion forms, a sense of exploration and a destination, no people. Playful architectural geometry rather than a landscape. Airy cream open middle and top. Tiny tasteful lilac secondary shapes. Bold elegant art direction.

resources.name: Ressourcen · Kraftatelier
resources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a real classroom-screen background for ClassJourney, wide 16:9 landscape, at least 1920 pixels wide. Modern European graphic-novel / comic-book illustration for 16–20 year old Swiss vocational students. Confident dark-navy ink contours with slight hand-drawn line variation, expressive simplified silhouettes, crisp cel shading in two or three tones, vivid but harmonious cobalt, turquoise-petrol, apricot-orange, lilac and sunny yellow. Playful, witty, contemporary and sophisticated, never preschool or corporate stock. Tiny selective halftone texture and hatching accents only. Flat drawn illustration, NOT photorealism, glossy 3D, paper-cut render or watercolor. Theme: personal resources, everyday energy and wellbeing, as an inviting Swiss teen study-and-recharge atelier. At the FAR LOWER LEFT a relaxed older teenager in cobalt casual clothes sits sideways in a bold apricot armchair, headphones resting around their neck, enjoying a short reading break; lively but natural expressive comic drawing. At the FAR LOWER RIGHT a big graphic leafy plant beside a chunky cobalt water bottle, a notebook and headphones on a lilac side table, a small sunny window detail. These are visible concrete resources for wellbeing, no medical procedures. A gentle curved floor stripe connects these corners to suggest a learning journey. Strongly comic-like and more fun than a neutral beige interior. Keep the CENTRAL 48 percent of the image and the top central area light pale sky-blue/ivory and low-detail for large white lesson cards; all focal objects and the character stay within the outer 22 percent edges and lower third. Use lively perspective, asymmetric angled room geometry and saturated accents at the sides, not an empty generic landscape. No mountains, no text, no digits, no logos, no flags, no wall posters with writing, no speech bubbles, no clocks, no interface, no card mockup, no decorative scatter behind the lesson cards.
